title: Grade 3 Maths — Thu, May 21
description: Telling Time — Hours and Minutes — Last Week Day 4
subject: mathematics

questions.question: The minute hand points to 12. The hour hand points to 4. What time is it?
questions.explanation: When the minute hand is at 12, it is exactly on the hour. Hour hand at 4 = 4:00.

questions.question: How many minutes are in one hour?
questions.explanation: There are 60 minutes in one hour. The minute hand goes all the way around in 60 minutes.

questions.question: The minute hand points to 6. The hour hand points to 3. What time is it?
questions.explanation: Minute hand at 6 = 30 minutes. Hour hand between 3 and 4, closer to 3. Time = 3:30.

questions.question: How many hours are in a day?
questions.explanation: There are 24 hours in a day — 12 AM hours and 12 PM hours.

questions.question: School starts at 8:30 AM and ends at 3:00 PM. How long is the school day?
questions.explanation: 8:30 AM to 3:00 PM: from 8:30 to 9:00 = 30 min; 9:00 to 3:00 = 6 hours. Total = 6 hours 30 minutes.

questions.question: The minute hand points to 3. How many minutes is that?
questions.explanation: Each number on the clock face = 5 minutes. Minute hand at 3 = 3 × 5 = 15 minutes.

questions.question: Which clock shows 'quarter past 5'?
questions.explanation: Quarter past 5 = 5:15. A quarter of an hour = 15 minutes.

questions.question: Raju started walking at 10:15 and finished at 10:45. How long did he walk?
What does AM stand for?
questions.explanation: AM = Ante Meridiem (Latin: before noon). Times from midnight (12:00) to noon (12:00) are AM.

questions.question: The movie starts at 5:45 PM and lasts 1 hour 30 minutes. When does it end?
questions.explanation: 5:45 PM + 1 hour = 6:45 PM; 6:45 PM + 30 minutes = 7:15 PM.

questions.question: Half past 9 is the same as:
questions.explanation: Half past 9 = 9:30. Half an hour = 30 minutes.

questions.question: How many minutes are in half an hour?
questions.explanation: Half an hour = 30 minutes. One hour = 60 minutes; 60 ÷ 2 = 30.

questions.question: Lunch is at 12:30. Recess ends at 11:45. How long until lunch?
questions.explanation: 11:45 to 12:00 = 15 minutes; 12:00 to 12:30 = 30 minutes. Total = 45 minutes.
